primary_design.name: B: whole-functional zero lift, preserving coordinated conditions
primary_design.data_lift: Y_up(t,b,j)=sigma(b)*Y(t,j), sigma=product_j(1-b_j); D needs one omitted feature bit, F needs three
primary_design.pcs_coefficients: data=(1-e)*sigma; mask_re=e*sigma; mask_im=u*e*sigma. Each physical terminal reserves an independent mask pair. The source point contains token coordinates and retained feature coordinates; its mask point is its own column tail/range.
primary_design.zero_case: sigma=0 implies the entire functional and terminal are zero. Shared trusted claim assembly MUST check terminal==0 before removing that functional. Keep the fixed terminal in the CFS transcript. Do not call native open_zk on an all-zero group and do not weaken its mask assertion. No division or retry.
primary_design.zero_group_schedule: Both sides derive the same normalized claim list from public challenges; native PCS groups and subsequent challenge draws follow that list. The final profile/wire count must handle public challenge-dependent group counts. Direct zero-functional tests establish the local adapter behavior, not full private-block wire handling.
primary_design.initial_identity: At extension e=0, sum over the Boolean feature cube of W0*Y0+W1_up*Y1_up equals the sum of the true two piece dot products because sigma^2=sigma. The initial scalar hosts the combined sum; never publish separate inner-piece sums.
primary_design.norm_identity: Use eq(r_t,t)*(Y0^2+Y1_up^2) in one sumcheck and add both square sums before deriving the single integer denominator. Every piece uses that shared denominator.
primary_design.extension_zero: Each affected matmul monomial contains its public folded weight; each norm monomial contains public token equality. These public tables extend to zero, so the polynomial at e=1 is zero. This obligation must be rechecked for the complete final SlotDef, including hosted terms.
primary_design.degrees: Lifted tables are affine in each feature variable. Dot-product coordinate degree <=2; equality times squared norm degree <=3. The one extension round has the same degree bounds. No reciprocal of sigma appears. These component bounds do not certify all future native zero-check degrees.

point_maps.moving_token_norm: source=(rho_token || retained rho_feature); remove only missing leading FEATURE coordinates after the token coordinates
point_maps.fixed_token_matmul: sumcheck runs only on feature bits; source=(fixed token point || retained rho_feature); sigma uses the missing leading feature challenges, never the fixed token coordinates
point_maps.pcs_grouping: Keep physical terminals in separate ZClaims when their source column tails/ranges differ. Sub-row sources retain their nonzero column offset in both data and mask slices. Removing feature coordinates can change which token coordinates lie in the column tail.

alternative_for_review_only.name: B-independent: data-only lift with independently extended site mask
alternative_for_review_only.coordinator_condition: This changes the coordinated whole-functional scaling condition. It is an experiment, not an adopted design or authorization for native work.
alternative_for_review_only.zero_case: At sigma=0 the terminal is a pure reserved-mask evaluation; the native mask-site assertion remains satisfied without zero-functional normalization. No extra retry or division.
alternative_for_review_only.algebra: The initial Boolean identity and degree bounds match the primary construction. The public weight/equality factor still kills each relevant monomial at extension e=1 even when the private mask is not lifted.
alternative_for_review_only.review_needed: Re-derive the CFS terminal/round coupling and joint mask rank for this extension choice. Passing component proofs does not establish privacy or extend existing approvals.

native_components.coverage: Four geometries, each at width ratio2 and8, sub-row and multi-row sources; moving-token dot sum, fixed-token matmul fold, moving-token norm; both mask styles. Fresh independent site/proximity masks, commitment pads/salts and CFS coefficients per attempt. All fixtures use public deterministic seeds.
